item.title: Ask HN: What if there was an 8th day of the week?
item.summary: Would it be another work day, weekend, or something else? What would it be called? Where would it fit nicely in the week? Sun Moon Tyr Wodan Thor Freya Saturn How would this change things in the modern world? Is there actually an optimum number of days in the week or is it just random?
